Proposition
[biinvariance criterion]

Source: petersen:page-0156, petersen:page-0157, petersen:page-0158 ↗ def:pet-ch4-adjoint-action ↗ prop:pet-ch4-left-translation-isometry 1. ch4:4.4.1A left-invariant metric on a Lie group $G$ is biinvariant if and only if $\mathrm{Ad}_g:\mathfrak g\to \mathfrak g$ is a linear isometry for every $g\in G$.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch4-biinvariant-criterion \sketch If the metric is biinvariant, conjugation $L_g\circ R_{g^{-1}}$ is an isometry, so its differential $\operatorname {Ad}_g$ is orthogonal. Conversely, $R_g=L_g\circ \operatorname {Ad}_{g^{-1}}$ at the identity; hence the hypothesis and subsection 4.1 make $(DR_g)_e$ an isometry. For any $h$, $(DR_g)_h=(DR_{hg})_e\circ ((DR_h)_e)^{-1}$, so every right translation is an isometry.

□
